problem: The minimum value of $Q(x)=8{x}_{1}^{2}-30{x}_{1}{x}_{2}-50{x}_{2}^{2},$ when $4{x}_{1}^{2}+25{x}_{2}^{2}=100,$ is $-250.$ Which of the following is a vector $x$ at which the minimum is attained?

activity_context.topic_title: Constrained Optimization of Quadratic Forms: Determining Where Extrema are Attained

feedback.worked_solution:
First, we write down the matrix of our quadratic form:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}9 & -2 \\ -2 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

Notice that we can write the constraint equation as follows:

$$
\frac{{x}_{1}^{2}}{{2}^{2}}+\frac{{x}_{2}^{2}}{{3}^{2}}=1
$$

This is an ellipse with semiaxes $a=2$ (along the ${x}_{1}$-axis) and $b=3$ (along the ${x}_{2}$-axis). If we introduce new variables

$\,$ ${y}_{1}=\frac{{x}_{1}}{2}\,$ and $\,{y}_{2}=\frac{{x}_{2}}{3},$

the equation of the ellipse will transform into ${y}_{1}^{2}+{y}_{2}^{2}=1$ or $‖y‖=1.$

So, introducing a change-of-coordinates matrix 

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}],
$$

 

we obtain that $x=Py.$ Substituting this into the expression of the quadratic form, we get

$$
Q(x)={x}^{T}\,Ax=(Py)^{T}A\,(Py)={y}^{T}\,({P}^{T}AP)y={Q}^{′}(y).
$$

As a result, since ${P}^{T}=P,$ the matrix of our quadratic form in new coordinates is 

$$
\begin{aligned}B & ={P}^{T}\,AP \\  & =PAP \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}9 & -2 \\ -2 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}18 & -4 \\ -6 & -12\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}36 & -12 \\ -12 & 36\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

Now, we maximize ${Q}^{′}(y)$ when $‖y‖=1,$ as usual. Calculating the eigenvalues $B,$ we obtain the following:   

$$
\begin{aligned}|B-\lambda I| & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}36-\lambda  & -12 \\ -12 & 36-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (36-\lambda )(36-\lambda )-144 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}-72\lambda +1\,152 & =0 \\ (\lambda -48)(\lambda -24) & =0 \\ \lambda  & =48,\,24\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
min{{Q}^{′}(y)\,|\,‖y‖=1}={\lambda }_{\text{min}}=24.
$$
